name: AETHER
summary: Verification codes, sign-in links, and 2FA in Droppy
description:
Standalone 2FA verification code, sign-in link, and TOTP authenticator droplet for Droppy — delivering full CodeCatch parity directly inside Droppy with zero companion app.

Watches Messages, Apple Mail, Gmail (OAuth PKCE), Outlook / Microsoft 365 (OAuth PKCE), iCloud, Yahoo, and IMAP mailboxes locally on your Mac, imports Bitwarden TOTP codes, enforces Touch ID / password protection, delivers arriving codes in Droppy's banner stack and notch HUD, exposes codes in Command Center and the Notch Shelf, and gates AI agent requests through Droppy MCP.
